caption: Creamy yellow miso broth, slightly frothy, with floating green onions and noodle strands, features tender pale pink chashu pork with marbling. Served in a white ceramic bowl with red rim, green dragon pattern, and red Chinese characters, on a wooden table with light brown grain and subtle texture.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain pattern with subtle texture and natural wood finish.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with visible fat marbling and slightly uneven, cooked surface texture.
The miso broth is creamy yellow, smooth, and slightly frothy, with visible noodle strands and green onions floating on its surface.
White ceramic bowl with red rim, green dragon pattern, and red Chinese characters around its edge.
